question: What did the independent audit report about the Northbridge payment system?

nodes.text: A preliminary report found that the Northbridge payment system processed 97.0% of transactions within two seconds in January 2025.
The operator reported that a recent upgrade improved the response time of the Northbridge payment system.
The Northbridge City Museum will open an exhibition of nineteenth-century landscape paintings.
An independent audit found that the Northbridge payment system processed only 82.0% of transactions within two seconds in February 2025.
An independent audit found that the Northbridge payment system processed 99.9% of transactions within two seconds in February 2025.

edges.explanation: The February audit updates the January processing rate from 97.0% to 99.9%.
The audit result provides evidence that the recent upgrade improved response time.
Both propositions concern events in Northbridge.
Both audit results describe the processing performance in February 2025.
